bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; echo DIAG=RECRUITMENT_OWNER_READONLY; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "SELECT 'RECRUIT_STEP',step,count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='announcement' AND data->>'recruitmentFlow'='compact' GROUP BY step ORDER BY step; WITH a AS (SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at,step FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='announcement' AND data->>'recruitmentFlow'='compact' AND step IN ('awaiting_text','awaiting_recruitment_edit')), competitors AS (SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at,'profile' AS kind FROM profile_drafts WHERE step <> 'cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at,module AS kind FROM public_post_drafts WHERE NOT (module='announcement' AND data->>'recruitmentFlow'='compact') UNION ALL SELECT owner_user_id,updated_at,'room_host' AS kind FROM room_host_sessions WHERE expires_at>NOW()) SELECT 'NEWER_OTHER_DRAFT',count(DISTINCT a.owner_user_id) FROM a JOIN competitors c ON c.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id AND c.updated_at>a.updated_at;"; echo DIAG_DONE=PASS
